ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized to linear and circular markings representing approximately 15% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base surface. High-contrast white clusters localized at the distal tips. Extensive white linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across the central and outer regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees, showing significant depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys with pixel-depth variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a distinct upward convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of white, circular/semi-circular pixel groups concentrated heavily on the outer distal edges of both lobes, indicative of barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, high-contrast white linear pixel paths (rake marks) intersecting across the majority of the black ventral surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring across both lobes consistent with predator interactions (rake marks) and heavy barnacle scarring on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: One prominent, thick white horizontal line located in the lower quadrant of the left lobe, showing higher pixel width than surrounding abrasions.
